DataOps Innovation Hackathon 2026

Build. Innovate. Secure.

The DataOps Innovation Hackathon 2026, organized by Hack The Core, is a virtual cybersecurity hackathon bringing together developers, cybersecurity enthusiasts, students, and technology innovators to build practical solutions for real-world security challenges.

This hackathon is an opportunity to explore how Artificial Intelligence, automation, security tooling, and intelligent data analysis can come together to transform the way cybersecurity assessments are performed.

Participants will be challenged to design and develop innovative solutions that can reason through complex security workflows, analyze information from multiple stages of an assessment, identify and prioritize security risks, and turn technical findings into meaningful, actionable outcomes.

The focus is not simply on building a tool that executes commands. Participants are encouraged to create solutions that demonstrate intelligent decision-making, automation, contextual analysis, safety controls, and clear communication of security findings.

What You Can Explore

Participants can leverage technologies and approaches across areas such as:

  • Artificial Intelligence & AI Agents
  • Cybersecurity & Security Automation
  • Reconnaissance & Security Assessment
  • Data Analysis & Intelligence
  • Vulnerability Identification & Risk Prioritization
  • Security Tool Integration & Automation
  • Automated Security Reporting
  • Intelligent Decision-Making

Who Can Participate?

The hackathon is open to students, developers, cybersecurity enthusiasts, researchers, and technology innovators who are interested in solving cybersecurity challenges through technology and innovation.

Whether you're an experienced security practitioner or someone exploring the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, this is an opportunity to build, experiment, and showcase your ideas.

What Makes This Hackathon Different?

Participants are encouraged to go beyond conventional automation and build solutions that can understand context, make informed decisions, correlate information, and explain their actions.

The emphasis is on creating solutions that are:

  • Innovative
  • Practical
  • Intelligent
  • Secure
  • Scalable

All implementations involving security testing must operate within the designated sandboxed/lab environment, with appropriate safety and human-approval controls for active security actions.

Event Details

2–7 November 2026
Virtual Hackathon
Hackathon Platform: Discord
Domain: Cybersecurity
Organized by: Hack The Core

The hackathon will be conducted virtually through Discord, which will serve as the central platform for participant communication, announcements, updates, discussions, and hackathon coordination.

Bring your ideas, build something meaningful, and push the boundaries of what intelligent cybersecurity solutions can achieve.

Think beyond automation. Build intelligence. Secure the future.
